explanation: This unit tracks the agent current preference for a2/S2: while the agent keeps choosing a2 it stays at 9-10 at D1 and GO and about 9 at a D2 reaching S2 (about 7 after a rare S1, 4-6 if that follows a loss), dipping to 6-9 at D1 after an unrewarded trial (lower, 2-5, after repeated losses or early in an a2 run). While the agent keeps choosing a1 it is low: D2 is 0-1 (S1) or 1-4 (rare S2), GO is 2-3 early in the episode and 4-7 late, D1 is 7-9 if the previous trial was rewarded and 0-1 if it was not.
